lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's eighteen? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 18? Nope!

lines.text: How many pairs of positive whole numbers have least common multiple seventy-two?
lines.caption: How many pairs of positive whole numbers have least common multiple 72?

lines.text: Order matters: eight, nine and nine, eight both count.
lines.caption: Order matters: (8, 9) and (9, 8) both count.

lines.text: Seventy-two is three twos times two threes. Split them up!
lines.caption: 72 is 3 twos times 2 threes. Split them up!

lines.text: Each number has zero to three twos, and one needs all three.
lines.caption: Each number has 0 to 3 twos, and one needs all 3.

lines.text: Last column and bottom row: four plus four, minus the corner. Seven!
lines.caption: Last column and bottom row: 4 plus 4, minus the corner. 7!

lines.text: For the threes, one needs both. Three plus three, minus one. Five!
lines.caption: For the threes, one needs both. 3 plus 3, minus 1. 5!

lines.text: Seven times five. That's thirty-five pairs!
lines.caption: 7 times 5. That's 35 pairs!

lines.text: Eighteen was the trap. It forgets order.
lines.caption: 18 was the trap. It forgets order.

lines.text: Did you get thirty-five? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 35? Tell me below!
